body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. The target moves up to 2 units along a clear supported path.

surges.html: Ignore ground difficult terrain during this movement.

rider.title: Air Thread
rider.html: Gain an Air Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: you may move 1 unit immediately before or after that card, without triggering movement Reactions.
